draft.title: Ashen Forest Crossing
draft.briefing: A long, travelled cart road follows the western edge of Ashen Forest. Pale ash gathers along its shoulders and over the woodland to the east. Brigands watch the road, strange creatures lurk among the trunks, and the far northern woodland contains the passage to Deep Ashen Forest. The earlier crossing remains in the central stretch.
draft.objective: Travel the long Ashen road, cross the forest and reach the far northern exit or passage to Deep Ashen Forest.
